title: Two tabs on a phone: Record and Pages
change: The phone tab bar has two tabs, Record and Pages, and the More drawer goes. Profile, Settings and Sign out sit behind the avatar at the top of the page.
evidence: Three of the More drawer’s four items were already in the tab bar.
notes: The page title still reads Home so only the shell changes; with the new Home it would read Pages. The avatar shows the initial, as the sidebar does today. Pages uses the panels icon from the app’s icon set.
